description: Edit an existing Excalidraw diagram with natural language instructions. Modifies the diagram based on your instructions and regenerates. Requires diagram_id from a previous create_excalidraw response. Costs 15 coins.

diagram_id.description: The diagram_id from a previous create_excalidraw response. MUST be from the actual response.

instructions.description: Natural language instructions describing what to change (e.g. 'add more detail to the flowchart', 'change colors to blue theme')
